room_rent.note: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses capped at 1% of sum insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of sum insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: All illnesses except accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of 537 procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 11

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 100% of sum insured in AYUSH hospitals or day care centres

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 2

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured; includes robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, stem cell therapy, oral chemotherapy, etc.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded in Annexure II List I (gloves, masks, etc.)

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 1

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace period for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI norms; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, organ donation, domiciliary hospitalisation, STDs (except HIV/AIDS), stem cell storage, ART for HIV, cosmetic/reconstructive prosthetics for disability
optional_riders: Co-payment waiver (additional premium to waive mandatory 20% co-pay)
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
